A free sailing simulator in your browser

VibeSail is a free sailing simulator and boat simulator with no download. Sail in the browser on desktop or mobile: wind angle, sail trim, and steering. Whether you call it a sail simulator, sailboat simulator, or boat simulator, it is the same browser experience: no install.

Yacht simulator and sailing games

Looking for a yacht simulator? You helm a sailboat: wind, course, and sail trim, not a motor yacht. It is also a free sailing game. If you are browsing sailing games, this one runs in the browser, with races and a tutorial, instead of a store install.

Compared with download sims and race apps

Many sailing simulators are desktop installs built for long passages. Virtual Regatta-style race apps focus on fleet tactics for a scheduled regatta. VibeSail is the free browser option: a sailboat simulator you can open immediately, with a daily race, cities and harbors, and other boats on the water. It is lighter than a full ocean-navigation suite, and it is not a season-long regatta manager.

Real sailing physics

Wind angle, sail trim, heel, and boat response all matter: a sailboat simulator that practices the same fundamentals used on the water.

Yes. VibeSail is a free online sailing simulator: open your browser, set sail, and play at no cost.

Do I need to download or install anything?

No. VibeSail is an online sailing game that runs in your browser. Visit vibesail.com and play with no download.

Can I play on mobile?

Yes. VibeSail supports desktop, mobile browsers, and gamepads.

How do I learn the controls?

Start with the interactive tutorial, then practice sail trim and tacking in Free Sail.

Both. You sail in the browser with wind, trim, and steering, and there is no download. Whether you call it a sail simulator or sailboat simulator, it is the same boat and the same physics.

You helm a sailboat, which is the yacht-simulator experience: wind and sail trim, not a motor yacht. It is a free sailing game. If you are looking through sailing games, this one plays online in the browser.

How is this different from a download sailing simulator or a Virtual Regatta-style app?

Download sailing simulators usually install a large offshore world. Virtual Regatta-style apps are built around fleet tactics for a scheduled race. VibeSail is a free browser sailing simulator with a daily race, harbors, and other boats on the water. It is lighter than a passage sim, and it is not a season-long regatta manager.
